_comment: Single source of truth for GitHub Secrets usage. Run scripts/audit-secrets-manifest.mjs (wired into code-audit.yml) to detect drift before it reaches production. To add a secret: declare it here AND add it to every workflow that needs it.

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Supabase service-role key (server-side writes, bypasses RLS)

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.description: Supabase anon key (public reads, subject to RLS)

BRIEF_EMAIL.description: Destination address for operational alerts and daily brief

REBRICKABLE_API_KEY.description: Rebrickable API key — set data, images, and catalogue sync

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for content generation and captions

BRICKSET_API_KEY.description: Brickset API key — MRP data, set metadata, retirement dates

NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Netlify auth token (legacy — origin host only, builds run on GHA)

GH_DISPATCH_TOKEN.description: GitHub PAT with workflow scope — used to trigger workflow_dispatch from scripts

IG_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Instagram System User access token (60-day, renew by 2026-07-16)

YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRETS.description: YouTube OAuth2 client secrets JSON for Shorts upload
